_comment: LIKE-FOR-LIKE FEDERATED TWIN OF run1. Same scenario/duration/realism/atmosphere/forces and the same ground stack (code+carrier+Doppler+TWSTFT to all 5 towers); the ONLY architectural change is multiAsset.mode 'joint'->'fast', which routes ReportRunner to runFederatedSwarm_: 6 INDEPENDENT single-asset EKFs plus SwarmRelativeSolver as a read-only relative layer. ISL error structure is MATCHED to what run1 actually had, not to its declared sigma: run1's coherent two-way PN range carries ~1.9e-05 m thermal plus a per-link CONSTANT hardware bias of 0.16-0.37 m (RMS 0.28 m) that it never estimates, with sigma inflated to 0.417 m to cover it. So here thermal=0.02 m (realistic wideband) and delayCal.sigma_const_m=0.28 m reproduces that constant-bias structure honestly. Modelling run1's 0.417 m as pure WHITE noise would flatter the federated path, because white averages down over 294 epochs per link and a constant bias does not. NOTE: the federated relative-CLOCK layer is left OFF because multiAsset.twoWayTimeTransferISL.enable is hard-blocked by validateMasterConfig:legacySatelliteTimeTransfer while SwarmRelativeSolver still reads that path — the clock half of the relative layer is orphaned. Shape is the beamforming question and its gate is unaffected.
